about: Roblox game links listed in games rotate through RoHub's ad spaces, marked Sponsored, next to a 'Want your game here?' card that points to TikTok @helmuts_world. Optional per game: text (a short line) and tag (a different label, like 🔥 Trending), for example {"url": "https://www.roblox.com/games/123", "text": "New Halloween update!"}. With no links, the ad spaces only show the 'Want your game here?' card.
